fields.label: Topic GUID
fields.description: UUID v4. Populated by the BCF controller when the topic row lands; the skeleton ships it as a plain unique field so the doctype can be created before that controller exists.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Open
In Progress
In Review
Resolved
Closed
Rejected

fields.label: Topic Type
fields.options:
Clash
Design Issue
RFI
Safety
Coordination
General
fields.description: Roadmap BIM-03. Note `discipline` is NOT here: it is roadmap BIM-05's first task and travels with the deferred clash work (plan §6).

fields.label: Resolution
fields.description: Required before a topic may be Closed. Enforced by `bcf_topic.py::guard_close_requires_resolution`, not only by the UI.

fields.label: Creation Author
fields.description: Display name of the person who raised the issue. Distinct from `owner`, which stores an account id/email.

fields.label: Last Modified By
fields.description: Display name of the last person to change this topic. Distinct from the standard `modified_by`, which stores an account id/email.

fields.label: WBS Task
fields.description: The WBS task this issue is raised against. It is the join key that makes the camera jump bidirectional: a Task returns its BCF topics' viewpoints, and a topic returns its task.

name: BCF Topic
_comment_flag_note: `_comments` is the flag this Frappe version reads; `allow_comments` is what the roadmap names and is kept for the reader who follows the document. Measured: tabDocType has no allow_comments column and document.py never mentions it.
